description: Source code for an internal HTTP client used in parallel test execution support within the Ginkgo testing framework, handling communication with a server via HTTP requests.

classes.name: httpClient
classes.description: Struct representing an HTTP client for communication with the test server.

methods.name: newHttpClient
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new httpClient instance with specified server host.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Checks if the server is reachable and responds with status OK.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the client connection (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: post
methods.description: Helper method to send POST requests with JSON data to the server.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Helper method to poll a server endpoint until a certain condition is met or an error occurs.

methods.name: PostSuiteWillBegin
methods.description: Sends a report indicating the test suite is about to begin.

methods.name: PostDidRun
methods.description: Sends a report after a test has run.

methods.name: PostSuiteDidEnd
methods.description: Sends a report indicating the test suite has ended.

methods.name: PostEmitProgressReport
methods.description: Sends a progress report during test execution.

methods.name: PostReportBeforeSuiteCompleted
methods.description: Reports that the 'before suite' phase has completed.

methods.name: BlockUntilReportBeforeSuiteCompleted
methods.description: Blocks until the report before suite completion is available.

methods.name: PostSynchronizedBeforeSuiteCompleted
methods.description: Posts the state and data after synchronized 'before suite' execution.

methods.name: BlockUntilSynchronizedBeforeSuiteData
methods.description: Blocks until synchronized 'before suite' data is available.

methods.name: BlockUntilNonprimaryProcsHaveFinished
methods.description: Blocks until non-primary processes have finished.

methods.name: BlockUntilAggregatedNonprimaryProcsReport
methods.description: Blocks until an aggregated report from non-primary processes is available.

methods.name: FetchNextCounter
methods.description: Fetches the next counter value from the server.

methods.name: PostAbort
methods.description: Instructs the server to abort the test run.

methods.name: ShouldAbort
methods.description: Checks if an abort has been signaled by the server.
